mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category, brand, summary, image_key, rating, sales_count FROM product WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE
SELECT id, sku_code, spec FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sku_code, spec, price, original_price, stock FROM product_sku WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE

SELECT 0 AS id, s.id AS sku_id, p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.spec, p.image_key, s.price, s.stock, #{quantity} AS quantity, TRUE AS selected FROM product_sku s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.id = #{skuId} AND s.enabled = TRUE AND p.enabled = TRUE
SELECT id FROM product WHERE id>#{cursor} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
